d:
Dr Sanjiv Goenka, Chairman of RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group, on building a conglomerate from businesses everyone else abandoned.
He explains:
• How he turned Kolkata's broken, debt-ridden power business into a turnaround story his own father called a stupid decision
• How billionaires spot business opportunities before everyone else sees them
• Why he believes the burn-money-to-grow unicorn culture is a fundamentally flawed way to build lasting companies
• What happened when his regulator and his competitor were the exact same person during a five-year legal war
